offending_extra_words: in all material respects to its documentation and specifications
The express warranties in this Section 9 are not limited or disclaimed by any other provision of this Agreement, including the disclaimer in Section 12.
reasons: Preferred is incomplete: the services warranty has no duration, so the required 90-day services period (measured from performance or completion) is absent.
Preferred conformance is weakened to "in all material respects"; the position requires deliverables/software to conform to documentation without a materiality qualifier.
Fallback is not satisfied either (no 30-day services period; software period stated at the preferred 12 months rather than the fallback 90 days), so the clause sits below both levels on duration.

Not minimal: "consistent with industry standards", "and specifications", the added "re-performance" remedy (the remedy set is repair, replacement, refund only) and the anti-disclaimer sentence go beyond what is needed to complete the preferred level.

Intent risk: the inserted cross-reference "the disclaimer in Section 12" is a dangling reference — the disclaimer language appears within Section 9 itself, creating a potential contradiction with the untouched "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH" paragraph.

Fix: add "and for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will conform to their documentation", delete the materiality qualifiers on conformance, delete "re-performance" and "consistent with industry standards", and drop the anti-disclaimer sentence or correct its cross-reference.
